description: Join us for an evening with Nicole Uhre-Balk (State House, District 32), Kehala Two Bulls (State Senate, District 34), and Current Representative Kameron Nelson on Friday, September 20, 2024, from 6:00 to 8:00 PM at 1205 West Boulevard, Rapid City, SD. Enjoy piano music, champagne, and light snacks.
title: Cheers to Change — nicoleforhouse.com
